MikroTik CRS305-1G-4S+IN – Compact 10G SFP+ Cloud Router Switch

Ultra-Fast, High-Performance, and Versatile 10G Fiber Switch

The MikroTik CRS305-1G-4S+IN is a powerful and compact Cloud Router Switch, ideal for high-speed fiber networking in enterprise, data center, and ISP environments. Equipped with four 10G SFP+ ports and one Gigabit Ethernet port, this switch delivers lightning-fast performance with minimal latency.


Its fanless metal desktop design ensures silent operation, while the dual boot system (RouterOS L5 or SwitchOS) allows users to optimize it for either advanced routing or efficient switching.


Key Features 

  • 10G Fiber Connectivity – 4 x SFP+ cages for ultra-fast data transmission.
  • Flexible Deployment – 1 x Gigabit LAN port for additional connectivity.
  • Dual Boot OS – Choose between RouterOS L5 or SwitchOS for optimized performance.
  • Silent & Efficient – Fanless, compact metal case for noise-free operation.
  • Powerful Performance – 800 MHz CPU & 512MB RAM for efficient traffic management.
  • Compact & Durable – Small form factor with a sturdy metallic desktop case.
  • Energy-Efficient Design – Low power consumption, ideal for continuous operation.
  • Reliable MikroTik Quality – Manufactured in Latvia, ensuring premium build quality.
  • 12-Month Limited Warranty – Guaranteed durability and long-term support.


Technical Specifications

  • Brand: MikroTik
  • Model: CRS305-1G-4S+IN
  • CPU: 800 MHz
  • RAM: 512MB
  • SFP+ Ports: 4 x 10G SFP+ cages
  • Ethernet Ports: 1 x Gigabit LAN
  • Operating System: RouterOS L5 / SwitchOS (dual boot)
  • Switching Capacity: 40 Gbps
  • Forwarding Rate: 59.2 Mpps
  • Form Factor: Compact, fanless metallic desktop case
  • Power Supply: External PSU included
  • Manufacturing Origin: Latvia
  • Warranty: 12-Month Limited Warranty

Ideal Applications

  • Data Centers & Enterprise Networks – High-speed fiber switching with low latency.
  • ISPs & Service Providers – Perfect for ultra-fast fiber connectivity.
  • Network Backbone & Aggregation – Seamless 10G fiber link aggregation.
  • Silent Office Environments – Fanless metal case for noise-free operation.


Why Choose MikroTik CRS305-1G-4S+IN?

  • Affordable 10G Networking – Professional-grade 10G SFP+ switch at a budget-friendly price.
  • Compact & Silent – Ideal for offices, home labs, and small network setups.
  • High-Speed Data Transfers – Lightning-fast connectivity with minimal packet loss.
  • Reliable & Future-Proof – Built with MikroTik’s advanced networking technology.
